buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Payment

PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of PB AO AKASHWANI NAGPUR A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Understanding the Additional Terms and Conditions for Vehicle Hiri ng Contracts 1.1. As and When Cab & Taxi For Akashvani Nagpur, Akola, Amrav ati, Chandrapur, Jalgaon, Dhule, Nanded, Parbhani, Yavatmal as pe r requirement. 1.2 The hired vehicle not daily basis as and when office interested f or vehicle booking, can call the agency for vehicle booking. Agency can not claim charges on monthly basis. 1.3 The Bidder shall always provide the staff car with valid registrat ion, fitness certificate, Pollution Clearance Certificate. The bidder s hall also undertake to comply with all relevant statutory provisions 1.4 The Staff Car vehicle shall be stationed at the premises of All In dia Radio AKASHWANI premises at different location whenever they called for booking. 1.5 The Agency shall maintain a log-book/ duty slip with mileage re cord in every trip and get it verified by the Officer-in-charge / Care Taker on duty after the trip. It is the responsibility of the drivers to ensure that the log book/ Duty slip is completed after each trip and signed by the Officer-in-charge / Care Taker ordering the moveme nt of the staff car. 1.6 The Car will be used as Staff Car for the official usage on trip re ntal basis. 1.7 The Car shall have valid registration to ply in the state of Mahar ashtra for commercial purposes. 1.8 The make & model of the car should be in conformity with cond ition as defined the GeM Bid / tender.

1.9 The Driver shall report to the office well in advance of start of of fice hour. 1.10 The vehicle so deployed shall always be in running condition a nd shall always comply with the provisions made under Motor Vehi cle Act. 1.12 The Driver deployed in the vehicle shall have valid license to r un the vehicle & should not have any Hit and Run cases against th em. 1.13. Performance security is applicable @ 5% of contract value in t he name of “PB AO Akashwani, Nagpur” in the nature of fixed depo sit or bank guarantee. 1.14. Buyer has full rights to allow relaxation of turnover in spite of MSE in respect with other fulfilment of documents. 1.15 Geographical presence of vehicle registration should be fro m Maharashtra state and registered office of agency should be in the city of Nagpur. Any rent agreement with other agency will not a ccepted only Gumasta and MSME certificate will be accepted. 1.16 Successful bidder should furnish the undertaking or contract o f hired vehicle in prescribed format to this office. 1.17 All disputes of the hired vehicle should be resolved by the age ncy without involving the office. 1.18 Preference will be given to the agency situated in Nagpur Mah arashtra 1.19 Turnover of the agency should be certified by CA as well as su pported by ITR for the last two years. Without ITR will not be entert ained. ITR should be financially sound for acceptance of your repre sentation. 1.20 Replacement of vehicle is not allowed without the knowledge of concern officer. 1.21 The office will have right to terminate the contract at any befo re expiring of contract due to exigency, poor service and not adheri ng the comply the instructions of the contract without assigning an y reason. 1.22 The fixed charges should be inclusive of all overhead charges like fuel, Lubricant, taxes, comprehensive insurance, payment to st aff/drivers, vehicle maintenance, & Night Halt Charges etc. Only To ll taxes paid extra as and when claimed. Hired vehicle having valid Toll passes and sufficient balance. 1.23 In case of any breakdown of a particular Vehicle deployed on hire to this Department during the course of a particular journey,

the concerned Transporter(s) shall bear the actual cost incurred by this department to complete that particular journey by alternative means of equivalent standard. The concerned transporter shall also be responsible to provide replacement of such broken down vehicle s at once. If the replacement vehicle is not provided within 1 hour a penalty of Rs.1000/- will be imposed for that day. 1.24 The concerned transporter(s) shall be fully responsible for any loss, damage or injury to any person, their belongings and/or any e quipment being transported by the department in the vehicles depl oyed on hire. 1.25 The concerned shall ensure that each and every vehicle deplo yed on hire to the department is covered by an appropriate compr ehensive insurance policy. 1.26 Penalty Clause : In case, the concerned transporter(s) fails to deploy the actual number of vehicles required by this department o n a particular day/occasion, this department shall be free to make alternate arrangements of equivalent standard from other sources. The entire and actual cost incurred by the department on making s uch alternative arrangements shall be fully borne by the concerned transporter(s) without any reference to the hire charges applicable under the contract with him. In addition to this, a penalty shall be l evied at the rate of 1000/- if vehicle is delayed for more than 15 M inutes. 1.27 In case the concerned transporter(s) fails to provide the vehicl e on any day(s), the recovery @ double the awarded rate per day s hall be done from the running bills. 1.28 The successful bidder shall ensure that proper account of eac h and every journey made by the vehicle deployed on hire to the d epartment is maintained by the respective drivers and is submitted to the transport in charge of this department at the end of a partic ular day. Log sheet of every vehicle should be certified by the actu al users on daily basis. 1.29 During official journey Toll imposed by the authorities, contrac tor can reimburse the same from office. 1.30 In case ambiguous or contradictory terms/condition mentione d, interpretations as may be advantageous to this department will be taken without any reference to the bidder. 1.31 payment can be delayed due to availability of funds hence bidder should consider the margin of at least 90 days. 1.32 PERFORMANCE SECURITY IS APPLICABLE AT THE RATE of 5% OF APPROXIMATE CONTRACT AMOUN T PER ANNUM IN THE NAME OF “PB AO AKASHWANI, NAGPUR” IN THE NATURE OF FIXED DEPOSIT / BA NK GAURANTEE. 1.33EMD/BID SECURITY IS APPLICABLE AT THE RATE of 5% OF CONTRACT AMOUNT IN THE FO

DETAILS OF PRE BID MEET : DATE : 16.11.2026 AT 16.00 HRS AT AKASHVANI CIVIL LINES PALM ROAD NAGPUR-440001. 1.34COLLECTION OF CERTIFICATES OF ATTENDING PRE BID MEET IS THE RESPONSIBILTY OF BI DDER.THE SAME SHOULD BE UPLOADED WITH BID DOCUMENT WITHOUT ATTENDANCE CERT IFICATE PARTICIPATION IN BID WILL NOT BE ENTERTAINED.
